items.title: Six AGIBOT G2 Robots Complete 1,730 Tasks in 24-Hour Shanghai Convenience Store Trial
items.excerpt: Four of the six robots pass a performance assessment as the trial puts customer service, retail operations and embodied AI capabilities to the test in a working store. The post Six AGIBOT G2 Robots Complete 1,730 Tasks in 24-Hour Shanghai Convenience Store Trial appeared first on The Robot Report .

items.title: How Rhoda AI is using video data to create generalized AI models for robots
items.excerpt: Rhoda AI offers a direct video action model, which it recently extended with mobile DVA, to enable robots to understand the physical world. The post How Rhoda AI is using video data to create generalized AI models for robots appeared first on The Robot Report .

items.title: Narwal builds robot vacuums to serve regional needs
items.excerpt: Narwal executives say they spent a decade in research and development and have tailored their household cleaning robots to local markets. The post Narwal builds robot vacuums to serve regional needs appeared first on The Robot Report .
